body:
### Summary

Hello uv folks.

In Fedora, we have triaged several already disclosed CVEs from pypa/virtualenv as they were reported to the uv package as well (reasons not important, happy to explain). With LLM (Claude Sonnet 5) I have found that CVE-2026-113716 is reproducible in uv 0.13.6 on Fedora Linux.

https://github.com/pypa/virtualenv/commit/554d9f9d4f7758f5cf53f993031e29787f1f74c5

`uv venv --allow-existing` creates the venv's bin/lib/site-packages directories with a plain recursive directory creation that does not check whether a path component is already a symlink, so a pre-planted directory symlink redirects the whole subtree outside the venv.

    mkdir v outside_pkgs
    ln -s "$PWD/outside_pkgs" v/bin
    uv venv --allow-existing v
    ls outside_pkgs/activate   # venv's bin/ contents landed outside v entirely 

I have reported this to security at astral.sh but this does not constitute vulnerability within uv’s attacker and threat models, hence I am reporting this as a regular bug.

### Platform

Fedora Linux

### Version

0.13.6

### Python version

any
title: Builtin creation follows linked environment directories
